testing_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, candidate cards, date controls, and ranking tables MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure at least 25 distinct pre-loaded/seeded real candidate profiles are accessible and selectable with valid-looking LinkedIn and public Instagram URLs.

Implement the full agent pipeline: URL submission -> Simulated Dual-Source Scrape -> Agent Persona Synthesis -> Needs/Hobbies/Interests display -> Interactive Dating Theater -> Compatibility Ranking Matrix.
Never leave background transparent without backdrop filters on sticky or overlay containers.
Do not use generic Inter font for main headings; use Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display.
Include data-testid on every button, link, tab, card, and interactive element.
